channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: Airlines told to cancel Paris flights on Sunday amid snow warnings in France
item.description: The French civil aviation authority has told airlines to restrict flights in and out of Paris airports on Sunday because of predicted snow and ice.

item.title: French prosecutors to set up special team to review Epstein files
item.description: The Paris prosecutor's office announced on Saturday it was setting up a special team of magistrates to analyse evidence that could implicate French nationals in the crimes of convicted US sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: France's Macron urges calm after killing of right-wing youth
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron called for calm and restraint on Saturday after the fatal beating of a 23-year-old French youth aligned with the far right on the sidelines of a conference by a hard-left lawmaker in the southeastern city of Lyon.

item.title: Citizenship, ski safety and babies: 6 essential articles for life in France
item.description: Why France’s Interior Minister is looking at naturalisation protocols, who’s who in the 2027 Presidential elections, skiing safety tips, plans to make babies more desirable, and driving licence points.

item.title: French word of the Day: Chiner
item.description: This is a word that has changed its meaning quite dramatically over time and has developed a whole new sense.

item.title: PODCAST: Le Pen faces the end and why France wants less meat but more babies
item.description: Welcome back to Talking France - this week's podcast covers the latest on the Le Pen trial, the ins and outs of private beaches in France and why the French government wants people to have more babies but eat less meat.

item.title: France urges public to eat less meat for the sake of the planet and their health
item.description: The French government issued a long-awaited report Wednesday urging people to limit meat consumption for their health and also to fight climate change -- and not everyone in the country of "steak-frites" is thrilled.

item.title: French 'Free Jazz' pioneer Michel Portal dies aged 90
item.description: Michel Portal, a French pioneer of European modern jazz and a prolific writer of film music, has died aged 90, his agent said on Sunday.

item.title: On the Agenda: What’s happening in France this week
item.description: Key dates in two religious calendars, MPs reopen the assisted dying debate, and Shein is set to open at five more BHV stores in France.

item.title: French 'ultra-left' behind killing of right-wing youth, says justice minister
item.description: French Justice Minister Gérald Darmanin said on Sunday that the "ultra-left" was behind the killing of a French youth aligned with the far right whose death has inflamed political tensions in the country.
